name: Transcription
pick: People listen to each recording and write down what is said (transcription), or check and correct a transcript.
summary: Listen to short recordings and write down what is said.
suggest: Also ask how clear the speech is, 1 to 5
Each person does at most 50 clips

examples.extraRating: How good is the audio quality?

examples: use one line instead of a big box

settings.title: Write down what you hear
settings.instructions: Listen to each recording and type exactly what is said, word for word, including repeated words. Write numbers as words. Mark words you cannot understand as [unclear].
settings.question: Write down exactly what is said
